forbidden: You do not have permission to open this page.
login_locked: This account is locked after too many failed attempts. Try again in {minutes} min.
login_rate_limited: Too many login attempts from this address. Try again in {minutes} min.
login_totp_hint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
login_totp_invalid: The code is wrong or was already used.
login_totp_expired: The login has timed out. Enter your password again.
home_intro: Content modules will appear in the menu as they are added.
account_password_changed: Password changed. Your other sessions were logged out.
account_totp_scan: Scan this code with an authenticator app, or enter the key by hand, then enter the 6-digit code.
users_password_reset: Password reset. All sessions of this user were logged out.
roles_all: All permissions, including modules added later.
roles_none: No permissions yet. Modules add their permission points here as they are added.
error_email_taken: This e-mail is already used by another account.
error_password_too_short: The password needs at least 12 characters.
error_last_admin: The instance needs at least one active administrator.
error_self: You cannot change your own role or disable yourself.
error_role_key_taken: A role with this key already exists.
error_invalid_role_key: Use 2–32 lowercase letters, digits, - or _, starting with a letter.
error_role_in_use: This role is still assigned to users.
error_totp_invalid: The code is wrong. Check the time on your device and try again.
setup_intro_full: Answer a few questions to set up this instance. This page closes for good once you finish.
setup_intro_admin: This instance was set up from a config file. Create the first administrator to finish.
setup_token_hint: The value of BLUEPAX_INSTALL_TOKEN in the server's .env.
setup_type_corporate_hint: Catalog, inquiries, regions, tracking, insights and AI on; all 13 blocks.
setup_type_blog_hint: Tracking, insights and AI on; article blocks. Modules can be switched later.
setup_frontend_url_hint: The public website that uses this CMS, e.g. https://www.example.com.
setup_content_languages_hint: BCP 47 codes separated by commas, e.g. zh-CN, en, ar.
setup_error_languages: Enter valid, unique BCP 47 language codes.
setup_error_primary: The primary language must be one of the content languages.
error_install_token_missing: BLUEPAX_INSTALL_TOKEN is not set on the server. Add it to .env and restart.
error_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
settings_invalid: Some fields are not valid. Please check the highlighted inputs.
settings_key_hint: Lowercase key such as whatsapp; the frontend turns it into a link and an icon.
settings_field_url: Enter http(s) addresses, one per line.
settings_type_hint: Changing the type does not switch modules on or off and deletes nothing.
settings_timezone_hint: Time zone the frontend shows dates in; data is always stored in UTC.
settings_brand_terms_hint: One per line: every name the brand is known by.
settings_publisher_hint: The publisher in the frontend's JSON-LD.
settings_publisher_name_hint: Leave empty to use the site name.
settings_branding_hint: The logo, the site icon and the theme color the frontend uses.
settings_content_languages_hint: BCP 47 language codes such as zh-CN, en or ar. Removing a language keeps its texts; adding it again brings them back.
settings_admin_language_hint: Admin UI language that new accounts start with.
settings_contact_hint: Contact details the frontend shows for the site; legal entities and their locations have their own.
settings_im_hint: The frontend's instant messaging button; independent of inquiries, clicks are not stored.
settings_im_text_hint: Text filled in when the chat opens, per language; may be empty.
settings_social_hint: The site's profiles on social platforms.
settings_entities_hint: May be empty. Company data is entered here only; it is not part of the instance config file.
settings_entity_delete_confirm: Delete this legal entity and all of its locations? This cannot be undone.
settings_entity_role_hint: Per language, for example headquarters or subsidiary.
settings_entity_public_hint: Numbers not marked public stay in the admin and are not delivered through the API.
settings_locations_hint: Branch locations of this entity: address, phone, email, coordinates and opening hours.
settings_location_country_hint: ISO 3166-1 two-letter code, for example CN.
settings_location_coordinates: Fill in latitude and longitude together, or leave both empty.
settings_nav_header_hint: Pages are flat; the site's hierarchy comes from nesting menu items, up to three levels.
settings_nav_footer_hint: Top-level items usually become footer column headings, with links below them.
settings_nav_delete_confirm: Delete this menu item and everything below it?
settings_nav_url_hint: A frontend path (such as /en/about), a full URL, mailto: or tel:; leave empty for a heading.
settings_footer_text_hint: For example the copyright line or a registration notice, per language.
settings_smtp_hint: Notification and password reset mail is sent through this server.
settings_smtp_off_hint: Without SMTP no mail is sent, and passwords can only be reset by an administrator.
settings_smtp_password_hint: Stored encrypted with ENCRYPTION_KEY and never shown again.
settings_smtp_password_kept: Set. Leave empty to keep it.
settings_smtp_from_hint: The sender name is always “BluePax CMS”.
settings_config_hint: The current instance configuration, in the same format as the config file in the deployment repository, without any secrets. After changing settings, download it here and commit it to the deployment repository; it is only imported when an instance is initialised.
settings_config_scope: Covers site, languages, frontend, modules, blocks and storage. Contact details, legal entities, navigation, footer and SMTP are site data and not part of the config file.
media_folders_hint: Create a folder here, or rename or delete the current one. Only empty folders can be deleted.
media_upload_hint: Images up to {image} MB, PDF and office documents up to {document} MB, videos up to {video} MB. Images get AVIF and WebP versions automatically.
media_empty: No files in this folder yet.
media_alt_hint: Describes the file for screen readers and search engines, per content language.
media_variants_hint: Generated from the original; the frontend picks the size and format that fit.
media_replace_hint: Keeps this media item and where it is used. The new file gets a new URL and new derived files; the old files are deleted right away. It must be of the same kind (image, video or document).
media_usages_hint: A file that is used cannot be deleted.
media_delete_hint: Deletes the file and its derived files. This cannot be undone.
media_delete_blocked: This file is used (see "Used in") and cannot be deleted. Remove it from those places first.
media_delete_confirm: Delete this file and its derived files? This cannot be undone.
media_storage_mode_hint: Files are stored on this server. Cloudflare R2 as mirror and delivery origin follows in a later version.
media_cache_hint: Media responses carry Cache-Control: public, max-age=<days × 86400>, immutable. Changes apply immediately.
media_limits_hint: Applies to new uploads and replacements.
media_picker_empty: No suitable files in the library.
media_picker_failed: The library could not be loaded.
media_usage_site_publisher: Settings → Site → Publisher logo or avatar
media_error_executable: Executable files and scripts are not allowed.
media_error_unsupported_type: This file type is not supported. Allowed: JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, AVIF, SVG, MP4, WebM, MOV, PDF and office documents (docx, xlsx, pptx, odt, ods, odp).
media_error_too_large: The file is larger than {limit} MB.
media_error_invalid_file: The file is damaged or cannot be read.
media_error_duplicate: This file is already in the library.
media_error_kind_mismatch: The new file must be of the same kind (image, video or document).
media_error_in_use: The file is used and cannot be deleted.
media_error_folder_exists: A folder with this name already exists here.
media_error_folder_not_empty: Only empty folders can be deleted.
media_error_folder_too_deep: Folders can be nested at most 5 levels deep.
media_error_folder_cycle: A folder cannot be moved into itself.
media_error_invalid_name: Enter a name of at most 100 characters without slashes.
media_error_not_square_png: The site icon must be a square PNG of at least {size} × {size} pixels.
media_error_upload_failed: The upload failed. Please try again.
settings_logo_hint: Shown by the frontend, e.g. in the header; SVG or PNG recommended.
settings_site_icon_hint: A square PNG of at least {size} × {size} pixels. The favicon, the Apple Touch icon and the PWA icons are generated from it.
settings_publisher_logo_hint: The publisher's logo in JSON-LD. Leave empty to use the site logo from Branding.
settings_publisher_avatar_hint: The publisher's avatar in JSON-LD, used only when no main author is set; with a main author, the main author's avatar is used.
pages_new_hint: Start with one language; add the others later in the editor. New pages are drafts.
pages_slug_hint: Lowercase Latin letters, digits and single hyphens, e.g. about-us; unique within the language.
pages_slug_home_hint: The home page lives at {path} (the home template); it still needs a slug.
pages_add_translation_hint: This page has no version in this language yet. It starts as a draft; you can copy the blocks of another language to begin with.
pages_unsaved: You have unsaved changes. Leave anyway?
pages_unpublish_confirm: The frontend will no longer show this language. Take it offline?
pages_live_hint: This language is published: saved changes are live right away.
pages_delete_translation_confirm: Delete the {locale} version and all its blocks? This cannot be undone.
pages_delete_confirm: Delete every language version of this page? This cannot be undone.
pages_home_set: This is now the home page.
pages_error_invalid: Some fields are invalid; check the highlighted inputs.
pages_error_slug_taken: Another page in this language uses this slug ({title}).
pages_error_slug_reserved: The frontend reserves this slug; choose another.
pages_error_edit_conflict: Someone else saved this language since you opened it. Copy your changes, reload the page and save again.
pages_error_invalid_status: Not possible in the current status; reload the page.
pages_error_home_page: The home page cannot be deleted; make another page the home page first.
pages_error_in_navigation: Menu items link to this page; change them first:
pages_error_last_translation: This is the only language version; delete the page instead.
pages_error_block_unavailable: This instance does not offer this block type.
pages_error_media: The chosen media item does not fit here.
blocks_none: No blocks yet. Add the first one below.
blocks_invalid: Some fields of this block are invalid.
blocks_invalid_hint: Blocks marked red have invalid fields, e.g. a button without text or a malformed link.
blocks_unavailable: This instance does not offer this block type (an optional module is off or the available blocks changed). It stays as it is; you can move or remove it but not change it.
blocks_module_editor: The editor for this block comes with the module it needs.
blocks_selector_hint: The spec selector bar needs the catalog module.
rich_text_link_prompt: Link (frontend path such as /en/about, full URL, mailto: or tel:; empty removes the link)
rich_text_link_invalid: This is not a valid link.
seo_preview_no_description: (no description; search engines pick text from the page)
seo_summary_hint: Answer the page's main question in one sentence, for summaries and AI citations.
seo_canonical_hint: Empty: generated from the route templates.
seo_og_image_hint: A 1200×630 JPG is generated from it.
seo_og_fallback: When empty: OG text → meta → global default; OG image → first image → global default share image.
seo_schema_hint: Simplified preview of the page's basic WebPage fields; the full JSON-LD comes from the API.
settings_frontend_hint: Frontend base URL, route templates and reserved slugs.
settings_frontend_reserved_hint: Paths taken by fixed sections of the frontend, one per line, e.g. search. Pages and posts cannot use them as slugs.
settings_frontend_route_segments_hint: Fixed segments of the route templates are reserved too.
settings_frontend_slug_in_use: These pages or posts already use a slug you want to reserve; change them first:
settings_routes_hint: The CMS builds every frontend address from these templates (canonical URLs, hreflang, sitemap, internal links and more), and the frontend implements its routes from the same templates. {locale} must be the first segment; the other segments are fixed and reserved as slugs automatically. Addresses are always lowercase, without a trailing slash.
settings_routes_home_note: Only {locale}. / redirects (301) to the home page of the primary language.
settings_routes_author_note: {locale} and {slug}, once each. Only authors with a public author page get an address.
settings_routes_issue_format: Must look like {example}: a leading /, no empty segments, no trailing /, at most 8 segments.
settings_routes_issue_segment: Fixed segments use lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens; a placeholder ({placeholders}) is a whole segment.
settings_routes_issue_placeholders: Needs {placeholders}, once each, and no other placeholder.
settings_routes_issue_overlap: Can produce the same address as the template for “{other}”, e.g. {example}.
settings_routes_issue_in_use: A fixed segment is used as a slug by pages or posts; see the list above.
settings_routes_slug_in_use: These pages or posts use a fixed segment of the templates as their slug; change them first:
settings_routes_confirm_text: The old addresses no longer lead to the content. Every move is recorded in the audit log; the seo module (a later version) writes 301 redirects for the old addresses from it.
settings_nav_page_hint: With a page, post category or post, each language's address follows the route templates; changing a slug needs no menu change.
media_error_not_image_or_video: Choose an image or a video.
posts_new_hint: Start with one language; add the others on the edit page. A new post is a draft, credited to the author linked to your account.
posts_add_translation_hint: This post has no version in this language yet. The new version is a draft; you can start from the excerpt, body and key takeaways of another language.
posts_excerpt_hint: Shown in lists, feeds and shares; when empty the frontend may cut the body.
posts_takeaways_hint: One point per line, at most 10.
posts_shared_hint: Cover, categories, tags and authors apply to every language of this post.
posts_cover_hint: The image of lists and shares; the OG image when none is set.
posts_categories_hint: The first one is the main category (e.g. for breadcrumbs).
posts_authors_hint: In the order they are credited.
posts_published_date_hint: Filled in on the first publish; may be set to a past time. Scheduled publishing comes later.
posts_live_hint: This language is published: saved changes are live at once and update the content date.
posts_delete_confirm: Delete every language of this post? This cannot be undone.
posts_delete_translation_confirm: Delete the {locale} version? This cannot be undone.
posts_categories_intro: Post categories are flat and ordered by their sort value. Their names and slugs are also part of the exported instance configuration (preset post categories).
posts_tags_intro: Deleting a tag removes it from every post.
posts_term_new_hint: Start with the name and slug of one language; add the others on the edit page.
posts_term_add_language: No {locale} version yet: fill in the form and save to add it.
posts_term_delete_translation_confirm: Delete the {locale} version? This cannot be undone.
posts_sort_order_hint: Lower numbers come first; shared by all languages.
posts_category_delete_confirm: Delete every language of this category? This cannot be undone.
posts_tag_delete_confirm: Delete this tag? It is removed from {count} posts. This cannot be undone.
posts_author_new_hint: Start with the display name and slug of one language; add the others on the edit page.
posts_authors_intro: Display name, job title, bio and slug are per language; avatar, sameAs, author page and linked account are shared.
posts_author_account_hint: An account can be linked to one author; posts it creates are credited to that author.
posts_author_public_page_hint: Only authors with a public page get an author page address (from the route templates).
posts_author_shared_hint: Applies to every language of this author.
posts_author_same_as_hint: Profiles of this author elsewhere, one http(s) address per line.
posts_author_no_page_note: The author page is not public, so the frontend has no such address.
posts_author_delete_confirm: Delete every language of this author? This cannot be undone.
posts_error_invalid: Some fields are invalid; check the highlighted inputs.
posts_error_slug_taken: Another item of this kind uses this slug in this language ({title}).
posts_error_slug_reserved: This slug is reserved by the frontend; choose another one.
posts_error_edit_conflict: Someone else saved this since you opened it. Copy your changes, reload the page and save again.
posts_error_invalid_status: This is not possible in the current status; reload the page.
posts_error_last_translation: This is the only language version; delete the whole item instead.
posts_error_in_use: It is still used here; change these first:
posts_error_has_posts: {count} posts still use it; remove it from them first.
posts_error_primary_author: This author is the site's main author (the Person publisher); choose another one in Settings → Site first.
posts_error_account_taken: This account is linked to another author ({title}).
posts_error_media: The chosen media item does not fit here.
blocks_posts_category_manual: Only posts of this category are offered; empty means all categories.
blocks_posts_chosen: Chosen posts (at most {max}, shown in this order)
settings_publisher_author_hint: With a Person publisher, the frontend's JSON-LD publisher comes from this author (display name, avatar, sameAs and author page); without one, the name, avatar and sameAs below are used.
